## Problem / 问题

What user problem would this solve? / 这会解决什么用户问题？

## Smallest example / 最小示例

Show the smallest EventAsset, capability, or editor interaction that demonstrates the need. / 展示能说明需求的最小 EventAsset、能力或编辑器交互。

## Boundary and evidence / 边界与证据

Would this change the EventAsset, capability/topic ABI, generated GDScript, source maps, or E0 lifecycle semantics? Include a proposed contract and the test evidence needed to accept it. / 这会改变 EventAsset、能力/主题 ABI、生成的 GDScript、源映射或 E0 生命周期语义吗？请提供拟议契约和验收所需的测试证据。
